escena: SCENE (cinematic, epic scale, a vast dark listening room at night, slight low camera angle): Sophia, the analytical strategist with thin gold-wire glasses, wearing the ROYAL-BLUE EFEONCE HOODIE, stands on the RIGHT side of the frame, framed from the waist up; her left shoulder is at about 60 % of the frame width and a wide band of empty darkness runs between the left edge of the frame and her body; camera about three meters away at chest height, 85mm f/2, REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS. Behind her, receding into the darkness on the right half of the frame, a towering curved wall of THOUSANDS of tiny live conversation bubbles and post thumbnails drifts slowly upward like a waterfall of social conversation, all dim cool azure, anonymous and softly out of focus. THE MOMENT: ONE single conversation bubble has just broken away from the wall and floats on the frame-right side of her face, between her and the right edge of the frame; she catches it with her left hand between two fingers at this exact instant and looks at it, not at the lens, with a contained, sharp smile. The caught bubble glows cool white and is the light on her face; at its center sits one small orange (#FF6500) dot, the only accent in the frame, which lights nothing around it. A long dark matte listening console runs between the camera and her, its near edge just in front of the lens. The wall never enters the left 45% of the frame. The LEFT 45% is calm, deep dark space with faint haze only. Enormous contrast, no logos of any other brand, no readable text.

lecho.objeto: the dark matte edge of the listening console close to the lens, outside every light

texto.muro: the calm, deep dark space on the left 45% of the frame

llave.fuente: the cool-white glowing conversation bubble she catches
llave.lado: to the frame-right of her face, at cheek height

fondo: the far top of the curved wall of conversation melted into cold azure bokeh

fenomeno.que: out of thousands of drifting conversations, one becomes a bright idea she catches in time
